summary: Router 0.22.1 reports the security posture of a configuration as facts (ADR-0064). New module posture.py: findings(cfg, environ) returns frozen Finding(code, severity, risk, text, next_step) for client_auth.mode not enforce (high), client_auth not locked, clients identified only by source address (medium; info with inference: false), clients sharing one token_sha256 (high; names only, never the hash), control port without users (high), unauthenticated loopback control access, API port without TLS, static nodes over plain HTTP to a non-loopback host without fingerprint, and a session store whose DSN (read from the environment variable named in session_store.dsn_env, never printed) uses an sslmode below verify-ca to a non-loopback host, or is unset (info). report() sorts by severity and ends with POSTURE: ok or counts. app.cli gains --posture <config> [--pure] (exit 0 with findings, 2 only for an invalid configuration); app.main logs each finding as a warning and the summary at start, without changing behaviour. The agent example configuration now binds a child Ollama to 127.0.0.1:11434 with the reason; it suggested all addresses, which made Ollama reachable around the router (TM-11). Docs: ADR-0064, README (EN/DE), CHANGELOG, threat model (EN/DE), risk register (TM-01, TM-11 stay open).

findings.evidence: Enforce, locked policy, separate tokens and TLS were only checkable by reading the configuration.
findings.resolution: Posture report on demand and on every start; proxy/IP behaviour in the deployment remains.

findings.evidence: The agent example configuration bound a child Ollama to all addresses; router-side transport to static nodes and the session store was not reported.
findings.resolution: Example binds to loopback; plaintext static nodes and unverified session-store TLS are reported. Backend listening addresses and egress need host inspection.

tests.evidence: 6 tests OK: each finding, clean configuration POSTURE: ok, no token hash or DSN in output, CLI process.

tests.command: All python test/... commands of ci.yml (WSL); check_adr_index; selftest_english_names; check_control_flow; ruff check .
tests.evidence: No failures; ADR index ok: 64 ADRs; ALLE OK; All checks passed.

limitations: Stacked on #110; the record is refreshed against main once #109 and #110 are merged.
The report reads only the router configuration and the session DSN's TLS mode; it cannot see a backend host's listening addresses or egress.
